# a2a_ex v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [A2A_EX](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [A2A](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.md): A2A protocol client + server building blocks.

- [A2A.AgentCard](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.AgentCard.md): Helpers for verifying agent card signatures.

- [A2A.Artifacts](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Artifacts.md): Utilities for merging artifact update events.

- [A2A.Client](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Client.md): Client entrypoint for A2A protocol operations.

- [A2A.Client.Config](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Client.Config.md): Client configuration for transport requests.

- [A2A.Client.Stream](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Client.Stream.md): Enumerable wrapper for streaming responses.
- [A2A.Context](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Context.md): Helpers for ensuring message and task context identifiers.

- [A2A.Error](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Error.md): Structured A2A error representation and mappings.

- [A2A.Extension](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Extension.md): Extension header and metadata helpers.

- [A2A.Server](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.md): Server helpers for building request context.

- [A2A.Server.AgentCardPlug](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.AgentCardPlug.md): Serves an agent card at the well-known discovery URI.

- [A2A.Server.Executor](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.Executor.md): Behaviour defining executor callbacks for server request handling.

- [A2A.Server.ExecutorRunner](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.ExecutorRunner.md): Helper for invoking executor callbacks with optional module options.

- [A2A.Server.Headers](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.Headers.md): Header parsing and response utilities for server plugs.

- [A2A.Server.JSONRPC.Plug](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.JSONRPC.Plug.md): Plug implementation for the A2A JSON-RPC transport.

- [A2A.Server.Push](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.Push.md): Sends push notifications to task subscribers.

- [A2A.Server.Push.Security](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.Push.Security.md): Webhook validation and optional replay/signature helpers.

- [A2A.Server.REST.Plug](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.REST.Plug.md): Plug implementation for the A2A REST transport.

- [A2A.Server.Router](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.Router.md): Router helpers for mounting A2A plugs in Plug or Phoenix routers.

- [A2A.Server.SSE](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.SSE.md): Helpers for encoding Server-Sent Events payloads.

- [A2A.Server.TaskStoreExecutor](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Server.TaskStoreExecutor.md): Wraps executor callbacks to persist tasks in a task store.

- [A2A.TaskState](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.TaskState.md): Encodes and decodes task status values.

- [A2A.TaskStore](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.TaskStore.md): Behaviour for task storage backends used by the server.

- [A2A.TaskStore.ETS](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.TaskStore.ETS.md): ETS-backed task store for local testing and small deployments.

- [A2A.Telemetry](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Telemetry.md): Minimal telemetry helper for recording spans.

- [A2A.Transport](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Transport.md): Behaviour for A2A protocol transports.

- [A2A.Transport.GRPC](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Transport.GRPC.md): Placeholder transport for unconfigured gRPC support.

- [A2A.Transport.JSONRPC](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Transport.JSONRPC.md): Client-side JSON-RPC transport implementation.

- [A2A.Transport.REST](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Transport.REST.md): Client-side REST transport implementation.

- [A2A.Transport.SSE](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Transport.SSE.md): SSE parsing and streaming helpers.

- [A2A.Transport.SSE.Parser](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Transport.SSE.Parser.md): Incremental parser state for SSE streams.

- [A2A.Types](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.md): Shared helpers for A2A type encoding/decoding.

- [A2A.Types.AgentCapabilities](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentCapabilities.md): Capabilities advertised by an agent.

- [A2A.Types.AgentCard](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentCard.md): Agent card document.

- [A2A.Types.AgentCardSignature](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentCardSignature.md): JWS signature metadata for agent cards.

- [A2A.Types.AgentExtension](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentExtension.md): Agent extension descriptor.

- [A2A.Types.AgentInterface](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentInterface.md): Transport binding metadata for an agent.

- [A2A.Types.AgentProvider](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentProvider.md): Provider metadata for an agent.

- [A2A.Types.AgentSkill](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AgentSkill.md): Agent skill metadata.

- [A2A.Types.Artifact](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.Artifact.md): Artifact payload.

- [A2A.Types.AuthenticationInfo](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.AuthenticationInfo.md): Authentication metadata for push config.

- [A2A.Types.CancelTaskRequest](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.CancelTaskRequest.md): Cancel task request payload.

- [A2A.Types.DataPart](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.DataPart.md): Data part payload.

- [A2A.Types.FilePart](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.FilePart.md): File part payload.

- [A2A.Types.GetTaskRequest](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.GetTaskRequest.md): Get task request payload.

- [A2A.Types.ListTasksRequest](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.ListTasksRequest.md): List tasks request payload.

- [A2A.Types.ListTasksResponse](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.ListTasksResponse.md): List tasks response payload.

- [A2A.Types.Message](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.Message.md): A2A message payload.

- [A2A.Types.Part](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.Part.md): Part discriminator helpers.

- [A2A.Types.PushNotificationConfig](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.PushNotificationConfig.md): Push notification configuration payload.

- [A2A.Types.SendMessageConfiguration](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.SendMessageConfiguration.md): Optional send message configuration.

- [A2A.Types.SendMessageRequest](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.SendMessageRequest.md): Send message request payload.

- [A2A.Types.SendMessageResponse](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.SendMessageResponse.md): Send message response payload.

- [A2A.Types.StreamError](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.StreamError.md): Stream error wrapper for streaming responses.

- [A2A.Types.StreamResponse](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.StreamResponse.md): Stream response payload container.

- [A2A.Types.Task](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.Task.md): Task payload.

- [A2A.Types.TaskArtifactUpdateEvent](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.TaskArtifactUpdateEvent.md): Stream event for artifact updates.

- [A2A.Types.TaskStatus](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.TaskStatus.md): Task status payload.

- [A2A.Types.TaskStatusUpdateEvent](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.TaskStatusUpdateEvent.md): Stream event for task status updates.

- [A2A.Types.TextPart](https://a2a-ex.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Types.TextPart.md): Text part payload.
